title: Target Account-workspace pending-work and attachment runtime composition

surfaces.currentBehavior: Executable Account-workspace lifecycle owner composing pending work, encrypted attachments, Client/Project stores and archive flows plus one exact-scope Space destination query behind the existing close-aware stream lease; every provider-owned observation, including Client/Project directory watches, drains before database close without implementing session ending.
surfaces.notes: Local target-only implementation. Wrong media keys fail during authenticated vault construction; partial opens close both databases; ordinary close drains operations, public streams and provider-owned budget-category observations before closing either database, while preserving all local work. Corrected implementation/harness commit f41a5ab78df1ec3cc9581fe8f4dad2083c8920f4 passed all three exact-head jobs in Actions run 33941609019; the later budget-category extension awaits its own exact implementation CI. No hosted, cleanup, signout or session-ending action exists.

surfaces: Account-workspace attachment and pending-work lifecycle owner
securityRequirements: Bind all storage to one validated environment, Principal and Account before opening it
Use a media key distinct from the workspace SQLCipher key and expose no key/path/identity material in diagnostics
No cleanup, deletion, signout or AccountSessionEnding capability exists
syncRequirements: Own exactly one pending-work provider observing the runtime's real structured and attachment evidence
Gate all existing finite operations and list/detail streams before deterministic terminal close and preserve all local evidence across restart

migration.rule: Compose only isolated target-local stores; read no Firebase cache, pending write, attachment or identity state.
reconciliation: A runtime summary must reconcile exactly to its owned structured-operation and attachment evidence

acceptance: Real-store counts, scope/key isolation, restart, concurrency, close and fail-closed boundaries pass without session-ending behavior

surfaces.currentBehavior: Executable tests exercise real encrypted runtime composition, constructor counts, key separation, attachments, pending summary, archive operations, exact Project/Inventory Space destination facade identities, subscription/provider drainage, restart, partial-open faults, deterministic close, and negative API boundaries.
